camel_example: aliyun cms CreateDynamicTagGroup --region cn-hangzhou --MatchExpress.1.TagName appname --ContactGroupList.1 ECS_Group --MatchExpress.1.TagValue instance --TagKey ecs_instance --MatchExpress.1.TagValueMatchFunction contains
description_en: You can call the CreateDynamicTagGroup operation to automatically create application groups using tags
description_zh: 调用CreateDynamicTagGroup接口通过标签自动创建应用分组
kebab_example: aliyun cms create-dynamic-tag-group --tag-key ecs_instance --contact-group-list ECS_Group --match-express TagName=appname TagValue=instance TagValueMatchFunction=contains --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDynamicTagGroup

parameters.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

For more information about how to query the tag keys of resources, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145558.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

关于如何查询资源的标签键，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145558.html
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
The alert contact groups. The value of N can be from 1 to 100. Alert notifications for the application group are sent to the alert contacts in these alert contact groups.

An alert contact group can contain one or more alert contacts. For more information about how to create alert contacts and alert contact groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114923.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114929.html. For more information about how to obtain alert contact groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114922.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警联系组。N的取值范围：1~100。应用分组的报警通知会发送给该报警联系组中的报警联系人。

报警联系组是一组报警联系人，可以包含一个或多个报警联系人。关于如何创建报警联系人和报警联系组，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114923.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114929.html。关于如何获取报警联系组，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114922.html
parameters.name: contact_group_list

fields.help_en: The key of the tag that is used to create the group. If multiple resources have this tag key, the resources that meet the filter conditions are added to the same group based on the same key-value pair
fields.help_zh: 用来创建分组的Tag的Key。如果包含此Key的资源有多个，那么会根据过滤条件，把符合的资源按相同的Key-Value，添加到相同的分组内
fields.name: tag_name

fields.help_en:
The value of the resource tag. The value of N is 1.

You must specify both the `MatchExpress.N.TagValueMatchFunction` and `MatchExpress.N.TagValue` parameters
fields.help_zh:
资源标签值。N取值为1。

参数`MatchExpress.N.TagValueMatchFunction`和`MatchExpress.N.TagValue`必须同时设置
fields.name: tag_value

fields.help_en:
The method that is used to match the values of resource tags. The value of N is 1. Valid values:

contains: includes.

startWith: prefix.

endWith: suffix.

notContains: does not include.

equals: equals.

all: all.

You must specify both the `MatchExpress.N.TagValueMatchFunction` and `MatchExpress.N.TagValue` parameters
fields.help_zh:
资源标签值的匹配方法。N的取值为1。取值：
contains：包含。
startWith：前缀。
endWith：后缀。
notContains：不包含。
equals：等于。
all：全部。

参数`MatchExpress.N.TagValueMatchFunction`和`MatchExpress.N.TagValue`必须同时设置
fields.name: tag_value_match_function

parameters.help_en: The match expressions that are used to create an application group from tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签生成应用分组的匹配表达式
parameters.name: match_express

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the tag belongs
parameters.name: tag_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically subscribe to event notifications for the application group. When a critical or warning event occurs on a resource in the application group, CloudMonitor sends an alert notification. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false (default): disabled
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组是否开启自动订阅事件通知。当应用分组内资源发生严重和警告级别的事件时，云监控发送报警通知。取值：

true：开启。

false（默认值）：关闭
parameters.name: enable_subscribe_event

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically install the CloudMonitor agent for the application group. CloudMonitor automatically installs the agent on the hosts in the application group. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false (default): disabled
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组是否开启自动安装云监控插件。云监控自动为应用分组内的主机安装云监控插件。取值：

true：开启。

false（默认值）：关闭
parameters.name: enable_install_agent

parameters.help_en:
The relationship between the conditional expressions for the tag values. Valid values:

and (default)

or
parameters.help_zh:
资源标签值的条件表达式之间的关系。取值：

and（默认值）：和。
or：或
parameters.name: match_express_filter_relation

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert template.

For more information about how to query the IDs of alert templates, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114982.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警模板ID。

关于如何查询报警模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114982.html
parameters.name: template_id_list

Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
